statement: A person is protected from unfair dismissal only after completing the minimum employment period with the employer: 6 months, or one year where the employer is a small business employer — one employing fewer than 15 employees, counting associated entities and regular casual employees.
caveat: Protection also requires modern-award or enterprise-agreement coverage or earnings below the high income threshold (section 382(b)); the threshold is indexed annually. General-protections and unlawful-termination claims carry no minimum employment period.
